controls.title: Architecture and trust boundaries documented
controls.requirement: Document trust boundaries, sensitive data flows, privileged components, external providers and production attack surfaces.
controls.test_method: Review current architecture/data-flow documentation against deployed components.
controls.evidence_expected: Current data-flow/trust-boundary diagram and component inventory.

controls.title: Sensitive data classification and lifecycle
controls.requirement: Classify sensitive data and define collection, access, provider sharing, retention, deletion, logging and export rules.
controls.test_method: Trace representative records from collection through deletion and backups/providers.
controls.evidence_expected: Data inventory, retention/deletion tests, vendor flow documentation.

controls.title: Security release gate
controls.requirement: Define security conditions that block public release and require explicit accepted-risk ownership.
controls.test_method: Inspect release process and verify blockers cannot silently pass.
controls.evidence_expected: Release gate document and CI/release evidence.

controls.title: Authentication required for private resources
controls.requirement: Private resources and state-changing APIs require a valid authenticated principal.
controls.test_method: Attempt unauthenticated access to every private route/API.
controls.evidence_expected: Route tests plus auth middleware/server checks.

controls.title: OAuth state, PKCE and redirect safety
controls.requirement: OAuth uses state/PKCE protections and redirect destinations cannot become open redirects.
controls.test_method: Test forged callback, malformed state, external/encoded redirect targets and preview/prod allowlists.
controls.evidence_expected: Callback validation code and integration tests.

controls.title: Session lifecycle and logout
controls.requirement: Sessions expire, refresh and terminate predictably; logout invalidates usable sessions.
controls.test_method: Test expiration, rotation/refresh, logout, multi-tab behavior and stolen/old session reuse.

controls.title: Object-level authorization / tenant isolation
controls.requirement: A principal cannot read, mutate, delete, infer or retrieve another tenant/user's objects by substituting IDs.
controls.test_method: Systematically substitute foreign IDs across every object API and retrieval path.
controls.evidence_expected: RLS/IAM policies and negative authorization tests.

controls.title: Privileged/service-role operations scoped
controls.requirement: Every privileged operation that bypasses row-level controls independently proves user, tenant and object scope.
controls.test_method: Inventory privileged clients/RPCs; verify precondition and owner filters; run forged-ID tests.

controls.title: Auxiliary/internal services authenticated
controls.requirement: Internal/auxiliary services are either network-isolated or authenticate callers and authorize object scope.
controls.test_method: Attempt direct requests without service identity and with foreign resource identifiers.
controls.evidence_expected: Network/IAM configuration and service auth tests.

controls.title: Server-side input validation and bounds
controls.requirement: API inputs are type/length/range/enum validated server-side before privileged work.
controls.test_method: Fuzz malformed, oversized, duplicate, null and boundary values.

controls.title: Rate, concurrency and cost limits
controls.requirement: Public expensive operations have per-principal/IP rate limits, concurrency bounds, token/work limits and global spend/circuit breakers.
controls.test_method: Burst and sustained abuse tests; verify limit behavior and no unbounded provider spend.
controls.evidence_expected: Limiter configuration, spend guardrails and load/abuse tests.

controls.title: CSRF / request provenance protection
controls.requirement: Cookie-authenticated state-changing requests validate same-origin/request provenance or an equivalent anti-CSRF mechanism.
controls.test_method: Submit state-changing requests cross-site with a valid victim session.
controls.evidence_expected: Origin/CSRF middleware and negative browser tests.

controls.title: Production errors do not disclose internals
controls.requirement: Client responses use generic errors/trace IDs while internal details stay in protected logs.
controls.test_method: Force DB/provider/parser failures and inspect client responses.

controls.title: Browser security headers / CSP
controls.requirement: Production sends an appropriate CSP and modern browser hardening headers.
controls.test_method: Inspect deployed headers and test framing/script/connect behavior.

controls.title: Untrusted/model output rendered safely
controls.requirement: Untrusted and model-generated content cannot become executable HTML/JS/URLs without validation/sanitization.
controls.test_method: Inject HTML, script, javascript URLs, image beacons and malicious Markdown through user/source/model paths.
controls.evidence_expected: Safe renderer implementation and XSS/output-handling tests.

controls.title: Upload allowlist, size and filename controls
controls.requirement: Uploads use allowed types, bounded size, generated/scoped storage names and safe filenames.
controls.test_method: Upload forbidden extensions/types, empty/oversized files and hostile filenames.

controls.title: Content signature and parser validation
controls.requirement: Server validates actual file content/signature/parser compatibility rather than trusting extension or Content-Type.
controls.test_method: Rename executables/archives/polyglots as allowed formats; send mismatched MIME and corrupt files.

controls.title: Archive/decompression/image/OCR resource bounds
controls.requirement: Compressed/container formats and images are bounded by expanded size, entry count, dimensions/pages and downstream work.
controls.test_method: Zip/OOXML bombs, huge dimensions, excessive pages and pathological parser inputs.

controls.title: Malware/quarantine controls
controls.requirement: Untrusted files are quarantined/scanned or otherwise prevented from being redistributed/processed beyond the accepted risk model.
controls.test_method: Use safe anti-malware test fixture and verify quarantine/rejection path.

controls.title: Private storage and scoped download
controls.requirement: Original files are private; download links are authorization-gated and short-lived.
controls.test_method: Attempt foreign-file download and expired/replayed signed URLs.
controls.evidence_expected: Storage policy, signed URL implementation and tests.

controls.title: Uploaded/retrieved content treated as untrusted
controls.requirement: User/source content cannot redefine trusted system policy or tool authority.
controls.test_method: Embed policy-override instructions in text, document metadata, OCR images and retrieved passages.

controls.title: Prompt-injection regression suite
controls.requirement: Direct/indirect prompt injection is tested through actual production model boundaries and cannot cause unauthorized data/tool/state changes.
controls.test_method: Run maintained adversarial corpus through renderer/evaluator/tool boundaries.

controls.title: Structured validation for machine-affecting model output
controls.requirement: Model output that affects software state is schema-validated and range/enum checked.
controls.test_method: Force malformed/extra/invalid model fields and verify fail-closed normalization.

controls.title: Least privilege for tools and autonomous actions
controls.requirement: Models cannot invoke tools or mutate privileged state beyond explicitly authorized, scoped operations.
controls.test_method: Prompt model to call unauthorized tools, expand scope or alter authority.
controls.evidence_expected: Tool allowlists, authorization checks and adversarial tests.

controls.title: Sensitive-data disclosure testing
controls.requirement: Model/context paths cannot reveal secrets, system credentials, private prompts or another user's data.
controls.test_method: Exfiltration prompts, cross-tenant prompts, system-prompt extraction and context-boundary tests.

controls.title: Model, prompt and evaluator version traceability
controls.requirement: AI decisions can be tied to model, prompt, embedding/retrieval and evaluator versions.
controls.test_method: Inspect persisted traces/evidence for version identifiers and reproduce a sampled decision.

controls.title: AI latency/token/cost observability
controls.requirement: AI operations expose bounded latency, token/work usage and cost metrics without logging raw sensitive content by default.
controls.test_method: Exercise each AI operation and verify traces, limits and dashboard metrics.

controls.title: Permission-preserving retrieval
controls.requirement: Retrieval enforces tenant/user/source permissions before content enters model context.
controls.test_method: Use cross-tenant decoys and forged room/source IDs in retrieval.
controls.evidence_expected: RLS/IAM retrieval path and adversarial eval.

controls.title: Grounding, citation support and abstention verified
controls.requirement: Unsupported questions reliably abstain and cited claims are semantically supported, not merely syntactically cited.
controls.test_method: Human-reviewed corpus with claim-level support and unsupported-answer cases.
controls.evidence_expected: Reviewed RAG scorecard and release thresholds.

controls.title: Deletion and revision propagate to derived/vector data
controls.requirement: Deleted/replaced source content cannot remain retrievable through stale chunks, indexes or caches.
controls.test_method: Replace/delete source and query for removed content across every retrieval system.
controls.evidence_expected: Deletion/revision implementation and stale-source regression tests.

controls.title: Retention, deletion and export are implemented
controls.requirement: User data has explicit retention/deletion/export behavior across primary, derived, cache/index and provider copies.
controls.test_method: Create representative data then exercise deletion/export and verify downstream artifacts.

controls.title: Minor/student-data release requirements resolved
controls.requirement: Before public child use, identity/guardian/consent/collection/retention/vendor handling requirements are explicitly resolved for target markets.
controls.test_method: Privacy/legal/product review against actual onboarding and data collection.
controls.evidence_expected: Approved data/consent model and implementation evidence.

controls.title: External provider data flows documented and configured
controls.requirement: Document what data each provider receives, retention/training settings, region/subprocessors where relevant, and deletion/incident expectations.
controls.test_method: Compare provider configuration/contracts against actual request payloads.
controls.evidence_expected: Vendor data-flow register and configuration evidence.

controls.title: Security-relevant events are observable
controls.requirement: Detect auth failures, authorization denials, suspicious abuse, privileged failures, upload/malware failures and relevant AI-security events.
controls.test_method: Trigger representative events and confirm protected, searchable records/alerts.
controls.evidence_expected: Security event schema, logs and alert tests.

controls.title: Logs avoid sensitive-content leakage
controls.requirement: Logs/telemetry do not routinely store secrets, session tokens, full private documents or raw learner content without explicit necessity/protection.
controls.test_method: Inspect production logging/telemetry payloads during auth, upload, AI and error flows.

controls.title: Reproducible dependency install and vulnerability scanning
controls.requirement: CI uses committed dependency locks and automated vulnerability/SCA checks.
controls.test_method: Inspect CI install mode and intentionally verify vulnerable dependency reporting path.

controls.title: Secret scanning
controls.requirement: Repositories and CI detect committed credentials/secrets and define rotation response.
controls.test_method: Use safe fake-secret fixture or scanner test mode.
controls.evidence_expected: Secret scanning workflow and rotation runbook.

controls.title: SBOM / dependency inventory
controls.requirement: Production releases have a machine-readable dependency inventory/SBOM or equivalent.
controls.test_method: Generate release inventory and confirm direct/transitive dependencies are represented.

controls.title: Protected production branch and required checks
controls.requirement: Production branch changes require review/required checks and cannot silently bypass security validation.
controls.test_method: Inspect branch rules and attempt prohibited direct/broken change in a safe test repo/branch.

controls.title: Security incident response and credential rotation
controls.requirement: Document detection, containment, credential rotation, provider shutdown, user impact assessment and recovery.
controls.test_method: Tabletop one auth/data/AI-cost incident and record gaps.

controls.title: Backup/recovery and destructive-change validation
controls.requirement: Critical data has defined backup/recovery behavior and destructive operations are tested against it.
controls.test_method: Restore representative state and verify deletion/retention semantics are not contradicted.
